title: Billings Gets a Brand New Bike Shop - NewsBreak
text:
By Traci Taylor ,
9 hours ago
If you love getting outside, cruising the trails, or just keeping your bike in good shape, there‚Äôs something new popping up in town that might catch your attention. A brand-new bicycle shop is preparing to open its doors in Billings, and the soft launch kicks off this weekend.
Meet The New Shop In Town The shop is called Shift Bikes Billings , and will be located at 1111 1st Ave North. Owner Joey is the face behind the new venture and brings serious experience to the table. He‚Äôs been a professional bike mechanic for more than 15 years and has been a bike-obsessed enthusiast for about 3 decades.
The goal is to create an inviting, welcoming atmosphere where riders can find top-tier service, solid advice, and bikes that fit their needs. The shop itself has been a long-time dream in the making, and Joey says the early support from the community has already meant a lot.

While the full grand opening is expected this spring, the shop will be open weekends through March and April so people can stop by, check things out, and get a feel for what‚Äôs coming.
From Quick Fixes To Custom Builds Whether you‚Äôre dealing with a stubborn flat tire, need a seasonal tune-up, or you‚Äôve been dreaming about building a custom bike from scratch, the shop plans to handle it all . Service and sales will both be part of the experience, with an emphasis on helping riders at every level.
That includes casual neighborhood cyclists, commuters, trail riders, and anyone just getting back into biking after a break.
A Dream Years In The Making Opening a shop like this doesn‚Äôt happen overnight. Joey says it has been a long-standing goal, and seeing it finally come together has been both exciting and humbling. He‚Äôs expressed genuine gratitude for the encouragement he‚Äôs already received and says he feels honored to serve the Billings cycling community.
Download the KCHH Mobile App Now When And Where To Check It Out If you‚Äôre curious, you can swing by during the soft launch weekends at 1111 1st Ave North. You can also learn more at shiftbikesbillings.com .
If biking is your thing, or even if you‚Äôve been thinking about getting back on two wheels, this could be a fun new spot to check out. It‚Äôs always nice seeing fresh local businesses take root, especially ones built around something as positive as getting outside and moving.
Do You Remember Eating Here? Billings‚Äô Most Missed Restaurants Take a trip down memory lane as Billings residents share the restaurants they still miss most. From cozy diners and family favorites to iconic spots that defined a generation, these eateries may be gone, but they are never forgotten. Gallery Credit: Traci Taylor Canva Jeff Kober Born in Billings, Montana, Jeff Kober left behind ranch life for Hollywood, building a career as a character actor in both TV and film, known for roles in China Beach, The Hills Have Eyes 2, and Criminal Minds. John Dahl Director John Dahl was born in Billings, Montana, and gained acclaim for his stylish thrillers like The Last Seduction and Red Rock West, earning a reputation as a master of modern noir. Bud Luckey Born in Billings, Montana, Bud Luckey became a beloved animator and voice actor, known for voicing characters in Pixar hits like The Incredibles and Toy Story 3 and for his work on Sesame Street. Stanley Anderson Billings-born actor Stanley Anderson had a rich stage career before transitioning to film and TV, lending his voice to documentaries and portraying authority figures in projects like Armageddon and The Rock. Jeremiah Slovarp Jeremiah Slovarp, a Billings native, is a multi-Emmy-winning sound designer and educator, known for his work on The Mountain Between Us and as faculty at Montana State University. Wally Kurth Soap opera star Wally Kurth, born in Billings, Montana, is best known for his longtime roles on General Hospital and Days of Our Lives, as well as his work as a producer. Mercedes Shirley Mercedes Shirley, born in Billings, Montana, appeared in classic television shows like The Twilight Zone and Matinee Theatre during her career in the mid-20th century. James Young Producer and director James Young was born in Billings, Montana, and worked on iconic projects like The Thing from Another World and General Hospital. Tom J. Astle Billings native Tom J. Astle is a writer and producer whose credits include Get Smart and Failure to Launch, blending comedy and action in popular Hollywood films. Tim Chantarangsu YouTube star and entertainer Tim Chantarangsu, aka Tim DeLaGhetto, was born in Billings, Montana, and rose to fame with viral videos, music, and TV appearances on Wild‚Äôn Out and Guy Code. Dick Whittinghill Born in Billings, Montana, Dick Whittinghill was a radio DJ and actor who appeared in musical films during the 1950s and became a familiar voice to generations of listeners. Noelle Drake Actress Noelle Drake, born in Billings, Montana, is known for roles in thrillers like Red Eye and TV shows including House. Andrea Albin Producer and writer Andrea Albin, born in Billings, Montana, began her career in horror journalism before launching into filmmaking, with projects like 3:17 and South Beach in production. Marlene Morrow Playboy model and actress Marlene Morrow was born in Billings, Montana. Her modeling career led to film appearances, including in Percy‚Äôs Progress and My Fair Lady. Zena Dell Lowe Zena Dell Lowe, a native of Billings, Montana, is a filmmaker and actress known for Rag Doll and her writing and directing contributions to independent cinema. Katie Blair Born in Billings, Montana, Katie Blair rose to fame as Miss Teen USA 2006 and appeared in projects like Jukebox and MTV‚Äôs Pageant Place. Daniel Amato Actor and producer Daniel Amato was born in Billings, Montana, and is known for roles in indie films like Missing Ingredient and The Last Day. Patrice Cole Billings-born Patrice Cole combined her talents as an actress and intuitive advisor, earning accolades for her work in spiritual guidance and appearances on paranormal-themed productions. Helen Lynch Silent film star Helen Lynch was born in Billings, Montana, and appeared in several 1920s films, including Romance of the Underworld and Bustin' Thru. Aimee Watson Actress and producer Aimee Watson, born in Billings, Montana, is known for her work in independent film and television, including We Men Are Lions and General Hospital. Mike Devereaux Mike Devereaux, a professional baseball outfielder born in Billings, Montana, played for several MLB teams and was named NLCS MVP in 1995 with the Atlanta Braves. Bruce Crippen Born in Billings, Montana, Bruce Crippen served in the Montana State Senate for over 20 years and made history as the only Republican from Yellowstone County elected to four terms. Dave Lewis Montana legislator Dave Lewis was born in Billings and dedicated decades to public service, including roles in the state House and Senate as well as various executive positions. Jerry J. O'Connell Jerry J. O‚ÄôConnell, born in Billings, Montana, served as a U.S. Representative from Montana in the 1930s and was a vocal advocate for labor and progressive causes. Dorothy Bradley Billings native Dorothy Bradley served multiple terms in the Montana House of Representatives and ran for Governor in 1992, becoming a respected voice for environmental and education issues. Gerald Pease Gerald Pease, a rancher and Montana State Senator, was born in Billings and represented Senate District 21, advocating for rural and Native communities. Jim Keane Born in Billings, Montana, Jim Keane has served in both the Montana House and Senate and is known for his work on labor, taxation, and economic development policy. Kendall J. Van Dyk Billings-born Kendall Van Dyk served in the Montana legislature and focused on public lands, education, and energy, with a background in natural resource policy. Lynda Moss Lynda Moss, a nonprofit executive and state legislator born in Billings, Montana, was a key figure in Montana's arts community and served as Senate Majority Whip. Robert K. O'Neill Navy SEAL and author Robert O'Neill was born in Billings, Montana, and is widely known for his role in the raid that killed Osama bin Laden, later becoming a public speaker and commentator. Skylar Deleon Born in Billings, Montana, Skylar Deleon was a former child actor on Mighty Morphin Power Rangers who was later convicted of a high-profile double murder. Leslie Spalding Leslie Spalding is a standout in Montana sports history, spending 10 years competing on the LPGA Tour and playing in tournaments around the globe. She's the only woman from the state to achieve this impressive feat. Jill Constantine Billings-born Jill Constantine is an economist and policy researcher known for her work with the RAND Corporation, focusing on education, labor markets, and program evaluation. Jordan Sullivan Jordan Sullivan, born in Billings, Montana, played college basketball for the University of Montana and later pursued coaching, contributing to the sport at the collegiate level. Laura Ziemer Environmental attorney Laura Ziemer, born in Billings, Montana, has worked extensively on western water policy and conservation, leading efforts with Trout Unlimited. Shann Schillinger Billings native Shann Schillinger played in the NFL as a safety after a standout college career at the University of Montana and later returned to coaching. Tanner Roderick Born in Billings, Montana, Tanner Roderick was a dual-sport athlete in college before playing professional football in the Canadian Football League. David Thatcher World War II hero David Thatcher was born in Billings, Montana, and was one of the Doolittle Raiders who carried out the first U.S. bombing mission over Japan after Pearl Harbor. Darrell Ehrlick Journalist and editor Darrell Ehrlick, born in Billings, Montana and is known for watchdog and political reporting. Kasey Austin Kasey Austin, born in Billings, Montana, is a nationally recognized adventure guide and travel leader known for her work with Austin Adventures, creating award-winning outdoor experiences. Kris Heavner Billings native Kris Heavner is a respected wildlife biologist and environmental consultant whose work has helped shape conservation strategies across the western U.S. Brett Keisel NFL defensive end Brett Keisel, born in Billings, Montana, played 13 seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers, earning two Super Bowl rings and becoming a fan favorite for his gritty play and iconic beard. Whitney Williams Born in Billings, Montana, Whitney Williams is a businesswoman and political figure who co-founded a global philanthropic consulting firm and ran for governor of Montana in 2020. Kim Gillan Kim Gillan, a longtime public servant born in Billings, represented the city in the Montana State Legislature and later served as a regional director for the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Hannah Slayton Hannah Slayton, born in Billings, Montana, gained attention as Miss Montana USA and has since built a platform around mental health awareness and youth empowerment. Jessica Baldwin Billings-born Jessica Baldwin is a singer, voice teacher, and creative entrepreneur known for helping artists develop authentic, genre-crossing vocal styles. Ty Eriksen Baseball player Ty Eriksen, born in Billings, Montana, has competed internationally and helped promote baseball in countries where the sport is still growing, including roles as a player and coach. Frank B. Morrison Frank B. Morrison, born in Billings, Montana, served as Governor of Nebraska from 1961 to 1967 and played a key role in expanding public institutions and services during his tenure. Barbara Ehrenreich Though more commonly associated with other regions, journalist and author Barbara Ehrenreich was born in Billings, Montana, and became a major voice in progressive writing with books like Nickel and Dimed. 2
